claim_boundary: v99 preserves candidate-bound equilibrium, sampled local ideal-MHD, complete stability, transport and exhaust, engineering, numerical VVUQ, and validation as separate evidence obligations. Missing evidence is qualification_incomplete, not unsupported and not physical rejection. No subgraph result can promote a whole device, and manufactured or reference controls receive no candidate credit.

reference_controls.claim_boundary: ITER values are published design/reference-scenario targets. ITER has not supplied an experimental D-T anchor for this fixture; model agreement would be regression to a design point, not experimental validation.

C-2W values are bounded published experimental ranges, but the L1 parallel-streaming operator omits fast-ion trapping, neutral-beam deposition, charge exchange, edge bias, active control and reconstructed FRC equilibrium. Disagreement falsifies this reduced operator for the anchor, not the C-2W experiment or FRC topology.
